_comment: Request matrix shared byte-for-byte by both builds (MYS-2826). `kind` uses RequestKind::as_str spellings; an absent `referer` means first-party, as the production request model does. `group` decides how a case may be used: `equal` cases are the ones both builds must decide identically by design, and they are the only ones a timing statement may rest on; `capability` cases deliberately exercise semantics only one build implements (AdGuard's 'an untyped $removeparam rule matches a document request only') and are reported as capability changes, never as work.

cases.label: script, query, no rule names it
cases.expectation: no rewrite: the query parses, nothing matches

cases.label: xhr, query, no rule names it
document, query, no rule names it
xhr, $xmlhttprequest-typed rule hit
cases.expectation: rewrite: track removed, keep and order preserved

cases.label: script, the $image-typed rule must not fire
document navigation, untyped rule hit
cases.expectation: rewrite: utm_source removed; the relay turns this into a 302, which this benchmark does not model

cases.label: POST navigation, untyped rule hit
cases.expectation: rewrite: webPushId removed; the body is the relay's concern, the URL is this function's

cases.label: document, host-scoped untyped rule hit
cases.expectation: rewrite: utm_psn removed, share_code and keep preserved

cases.label: document, empty-valued parameter (utm_source=): candidate removes, baseline keeps
cases.expectation: differs by design: $removeparam=name names every occurrence, including an empty value

cases.label: duplicate parameter names, none named by a rule
cases.expectation: no rewrite: order and duplicates preserved

cases.label: no referer, scoped rule names a different host
cases.expectation: no rewrite: the rule is anchored at shop.example.com

cases.label: xhr, untyped rule: candidate applies document-only, baseline rewrites
cases.expectation: differs by design: AdGuard makes an untyped $removeparam rule a document-only rule

cases.label: script, untyped rule: candidate applies document-only, baseline rewrites
cases.expectation: no rewrite: an untyped $removeparam rule is document-only, and the engine applies it to document/subdocument/xhr only

cases.label: image, untyped rule: candidate applies document-only, baseline rewrites
cases.expectation: no rewrite: an untyped $removeparam rule is document-only, and the engine applies it to document/subdocument/xhr only

cases.label: document, hit with a fragment
cases.expectation: rewrite: both named parameters removed, fragment kept byte for byte
